title: Argus vertical manifest (vertical.json)
description: Store metadata for one vertical in argus-verticals. Lives next to the vertical's stages.py. The one-line purpose is NOT repeated here: scripts/build_catalog.py reads VERTICAL_PURPOSE, VERTICAL_SKILL_PARENTS and the presence of VERTICAL_SKILLS from stages.py and merges them into catalog.json.

name.description: The vertical's name; equals its entry-point name in pyproject.toml and the directory path joined with '_'.

version.description: Semantic version of this vertical's directory. Bump it whenever a file under `paths` changes; the release archive is named <name>-<version>.zip.

module.description: The stages module Argus loads; equals the entry-point target in pyproject.toml.

purpose_zh.description: Optional faithful Chinese rendering of VERTICAL_PURPOSE for the store's UI. The English purpose itself lives only in stages.py.

paths.description: Repo-relative directories that make up the vertical (the directory holding stages.py first). Another vertical's directory nested inside one of these (digital_circuit/benchmark inside digital_circuit) is never part of this vertical's archive.

requires.description: Other catalog verticals that must be installed with this one: its code imports them, or its VERTICAL_SKILL_PARENTS names them. Argus built-ins (kernel_engineering) are not listed.

shared.description: Repo-relative helper directories that are not verticals but are bundled into this vertical's archive because its code imports them (argus_verticals/literary/shared).

python_requirements.description: Third-party pip requirements (PEP 508 strings, copied from an extra in pyproject.toml) that the vertical's runtime code, including bundled shared helpers, imports unguarded. The store does not pip install; it shows these to the operator.

optional_python_requirements.description: Requirements imported only behind a guard (try/except or lazily inside a function); the vertical works without them with a documented gap.

tags.description: Two to four short lowercase tags for browsing.

maintainers.description: GitHub handles (with the leading @) of the people who review changes to this vertical. Empty is allowed.

min_argus.description: Free-form label of the oldest Argus commit family this vertical is written for. The store compares by feature probe, not by this string.
